title: Tim Fernholz's 'OpenAI Adds a Prominent AI Doomer to Its Board of Directors'. Humanity Already Owns OpenAI. Nobody Asked Humanity.
short_version: Humanity already owns OpenAI: since October the Foundation appoints every director and holds 26% of the equity. The Foundation's eleven-person board picks itself. All the votes, none of the choosing. 51% was never the number.
